final_candidates.decision_summary: Charge-reversal in the Sa antigenic site is a classic escape mechanism with tolerable structural impact. Retained as the strongest candidate.

Surface-exposed, structurally conservative Gln-to-Arg adds positive charge adjacent to an escape hotspot, modestly raising confidence.

stop_reason.detail: Candidate pool converged after self-review; additional rounds without external evidence would not improve the Top-3.
